title: Bug: `voq/test_voq_chassis_app_db_consistency.py` is flaky because portchannel isn't created in time.
author: Javier-Tan
body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

Low

### Description of the bug

After creating the portchannel and adding the interface and members, the test runs `time.sleep(30)` to allow the DUT to update (chassis DB etc.). We see on our dT2 devices that this causes flakiness as the device doesn't update in time.

Because this test runs with reboot/config reload with config save/config reload without config save, it usually happens on the 2nd/3rd iteration, maybe as a result of the previous operation.

### Steps to Reproduce

Run the test multiple times, see it fails with:
`Failed: Portchannel Neigh ip 10.0.0.1 is not allocatioed to tmp portchannel PortChannel999`

and usually:
```
During handling of the above exception, another exception occurred:

Traceback (most recent call last):
...
tests.common.errors.RunAnsibleModuleFail: run module shell failed, Ansible Results =>
failed = True
changed = True
rc = 1
cmd = sudo config interface -n asic0 ip remove PortChannel999 10.0.0.0/31
start = 2025-08-17 09:15:10.293093
end = 2025-08-17 09:15:10.635019
delta = 0:00:00.341926
msg = non-zero return code
invocation = {'module_args': {'_raw_params': 'sudo config interface -n asic0 ip remove PortChannel999 10.0.0.0/31', '_uses_shell': True, 'warn': False, 'stdin_add_newline': True, 'strip_empty_ends': True, 'argv': None, 'chdir': None, 'executable': None, 'creates': None, 'removes': None, 'stdin': None}}
_ansible_no_log = None
stdout =
stderr =
Cannot find device "PortChannel999"
```


### Actual Behavior and Expected Behavior

It shouldn't be flaky, increasingt the delay should fix it

### Relevant log output

```shell
N/A
```

### Output of `show version`

```shell
20250305
```

N/A
